title: Tenki Sandbox
description: Gives agents a disposable Tenki Sandbox Linux VM for running code and shell commands, editing files and working with git repositories.
One session, created on first use, is shared by every caller of a running pipeline: its files and installed packages are visible to all of them, so use one pipeline per user or trust boundary.

tenki.apikey.title: API Key
tenki.apikey.description: Tenki workspace API key (starts with tk_), from the API Keys screen in the Tenki console.

tenki.base_url.title: API URL
tenki.base_url.description: Tenki Sandbox API endpoint. Leave empty for the default (https://api.tenki.cloud).

tenki.cpu_cores.title: CPU Cores
tenki.cpu_cores.description: Virtual CPUs for the sandbox VM.

tenki.memory_mb.title: Memory (MB)
tenki.memory_mb.description: Memory for the sandbox VM, in MB. Tenki requires an even number.

tenki.disk_size_gb.title: Disk Size (GB)
tenki.disk_size_gb.description: Root disk size, in GB. 5 is Tenki's default; Tenki recommends 20 for agents that clone repositories and install dependencies.

tenki.idle_timeout_minutes.title: Idle Timeout (minutes)
tenki.idle_timeout_minutes.description: Tenki pauses the session after this many minutes without activity. A pause keeps memory and files under /home/tenki but clears /tmp; it does not terminate the session.

tenki.max_duration_minutes.title: Max Duration (minutes)
tenki.max_duration_minutes.description: Upper bound on each session's lifetime, set when it is created: the cost backstop if the pipeline never shuts the session down, for example after an engine crash. It limits each session, not total spend: once a session ends, the next command or file write starts a new one.

tenki.exec_timeout_secs.title: Execution Timeout (seconds)
tenki.exec_timeout_secs.description: Max seconds a single run_command/run_code call may take.

tenki.max_output_chars.title: Max Output (characters)
tenki.max_output_chars.description: Output longer than this is truncated before being returned to the agent.

tenki.image.title: Image
tenki.image.description: Registry image to start the sandbox from, such as a template build like myworkspace/my-node-env. Leave empty for Tenki's base image.

tenki.toolGroups.title: Tool groups
tenki.toolGroups.description: Which groups of Tenki Sandbox tools this node publishes to the agent: execution (run commands and code), filesystem (write, read, list and delete files) and git (clone, check out, diff and log). Leave this empty to publish all three (11 tools). Naming groups publishes only those, and a value that names only unknown groups stops the pipeline at startup.
